description: This file contains functions and scripts for upgrading OpenMesh devices, including handling image sizes, checksums, partition detection, and environment configuration for the device's firmware upgrade process.

methods.name: cfg_value_get
methods.description: Parses the configuration file content to extract the value of a specified parameter within a specific section.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_openmesh
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade for OpenMesh devices by flashing the new image, updating U-Boot environment variables, and selecting the appropriate partition to boot from.
